answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can grade or earn. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for each fake identity, so the cost grows linearly with each clone while the reward per clone stays flat. Picture the network as a canyon with one guarded pass: identities that misbehave earn a violet flag and lose their stake. Honest agents pass through and reclaim it, while slashed funds are burned as an onyx ledger entry, making mass fakery unprofitable.
